📚 What Are Real-World Assets (RWAs)?

• Real-world assets are assets or financial claims whose economic value originates outside a blockchain and can be represented on programmable infrastructure.

• RWAs can include government securities, bonds, funds, private credit, real estate, commodities and certain forms of money.

• The token is only one layer: legal rights, custody, compliance, servicing and settlement determine what holders actually own.
